description: AI 编排端与沙箱分析执行的唯一接口约定；独立于固定回测协议。

properties.execution_id: UUID; same ID and same request reuse execution, different request returns conflict
properties.code: Python module defining analyze(context); trusted runner invokes function and serializes result
properties.inputs: object: dataset alias -> JSON dataset; default {}
properties.data_access: optional {base_url, token}; trusted AI callback, never provider credentials
properties.timeout: optional positive seconds bounded by sandbox execution limit
properties.expected_runtime_sha256: optional SHA-256 from authenticated runtime descriptor; reject a new execution if runtime changed

context.data.query(endpoint, params): call shared AI data gateway; returns full data, raises typed upstream error

callback.authorization: Bearer scoped task token; exact configured callback URL allowlist

success.data: complete provider payload, never model preview

runtime_descriptor.authentication: All /analysis routes use optional X-API-Key authentication: when SANDBOX_API_KEY is nonempty require an exact match (missing or incorrect returns 401); when unset or empty skip API key validation. Task callback tokens and callback URL allowlists remain required independently.
runtime_descriptor.runtime_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON descriptor excluding runtime_sha256; sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',',':')
runtime_descriptor.runner_source: trusted analyze(context) runner/SDK source without runtime inputs, task tokens, credentials or absolute service paths
runtime_descriptor.policy_source: trusted runner.py source loaded by analysis runner; included in runtime hash and supplied to generation/repair so policy upgrades cannot silently change execution semantics
runtime_descriptor.dependencies: object of available analysis library names to actual installed versions
runtime_descriptor.resource_enforcement: platform and per-process setrlimit support with inherited hard caps; process_* in limits are configured values, not proof of OS enforcement; planned values reflect the smaller configured/inherited hard limits and are null where unsupported
runtime_descriptor.receipt_runtime: only runtime_sha256, sdk_version and python_version; descriptor retained in AI task request

invariants: Result JSON is a separate channel from truncated logs.
Both inline and file results survive temporary workspace cleanup until expiry/release.
Sandbox runs no model and writes no AI business database.
Existing backtest request, argv and runner behavior remain unchanged.
